commands_used: answer 1. I serve the Toh-Reel-Ka as a Voh-Vastei. Hist trees are sick, Unbound drain sap, and the Eye of Argonia (a Hist-amber jewel at the Root) could heal the trees. Someone in Gideon market sells an "Eye of Argonia"; we need to know if it is real. 2. Find the dealer in Gideon market selling the Eye and learn about it; Ovinius Calo is the marker person and the Eye (Glass) is here. 3. Talk to Ovinius Calo, persuade or pay him, examine the Eye. 4. The marker also points to Rootworm Landing in Helstrom, which I do not understand. The Eye is listed as Glass, so it may be a fake; I can find out by talking.

answer 1. The Eye at the stall is only glass. Smugglers sold it to Ovinius and kept the old silver setting at Gideon South Watch. A relic-hunter called the Collector is also asking after the Eye. 2. Go to Gideon South Watch, a leaning tower SE of the quay, and take the setting from the locked chest in the inner room. 3. Fight the smugglers, sneak past, pick the chest lock, or take the key from the boss. 4. I do not know who the Collector is or why the setting matters; I might learn more at the tower or by asking.
take Key to the Smugglers' Chest

answer 1. I killed the smuggler boss and took the old silver setting. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, an Imperial relic-hunter, had opened the chest first and left a note saying a ship name is scratched inside the band. 2. Take the setting to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom by the rootworm from Gideon Hist garden. 3. Go straight back, or first read the Collector note (I have not yet taken it) and look at the ship name. 4. I do not know which ship the name refers to or what the Collector wants; Nesh-Deeka or the note may tell me.

answer 1. The Eye in Gideon was glass. Its setting names the Pale Harvest, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight with a dealer stock aboard. Nesh-Deeka knew the Unbound asked after the glass Eye a month ago, and paid me 100 gold. The quest is complete. 2. Nothing is set yet; the wreck in Hatandros Bight (east coast south of Thorn) is the likely next lead, and Nesh-Deeka may give orders. 3. Ask Nesh-Deeka further, or go to Hatandros Bight and search the wreck. 4. I do not know how the real Eye relates to the Pale Harvest, or how the order learns what it knows ("we listen").

answer I am a Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka, working for Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. The Eye of Argonia on Ovinius Calo stall in Gideon was glass; I paid him 20 gold and learned the smugglers had the old silver setting at Gideon South Watch. I killed their boss, opened the chest with his key and took the setting and the Collector note. The Collector is Ennodius Vanin, an Imperial relic-hunter who has hunted the Eye for twenty years. The setting has the ship name Pale Harvest scratched inside, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight (east coast south of Thorn) with a Gideon dealer stock aboard. Nesh-Deeka paid me 100 gold and gave the setting back, so I still carry it, plus the Collector note. She says the Unbound asked after the glass Eye in Gideon a month ago, and she says "we listen". Next lead: the wreck in Hatandros Bight; the real Eye may have been aboard. Still unknown: whether the real Eye is there, and what the Unbound know.
